code_path_inventory.entry_price: open of bar signal_index+1 (next_open after confirm close)
code_path_inventory.episode_begin: confirming bar close (signal known); forward from next open
code_path_inventory.episode_end_raw: first subsequent bar with direction != signal_dir (UNCLEAR or opposite)
code_path_inventory.forward_horizons: fixed bars from entry, independent of scanner state
code_path_inventory.first_touch: first_touch() high/low vs targets; SAME_CANDLE_AMBIGUOUS if both same bar
code_path_inventory.percent_scaling: percent points (0.27 means 0.27%); single *100 after ratio

prior_audit_0_27_interpretation: Prior median_mfe_60m≈0.27% was FIXED-HORIZON MFE (episode-independent), stored as percent points (0.27 means 0.27%). Not a double-scale bug.
